tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List Greenhouse jobs (id, name, status, requisition id, open/close dates)

per_page.description: Jobs to return per page (default 25, max 500)

page.description: Page of results to return (default 1, max 500)

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: List Greenhouse candidates, optionally filtered by job or email address

per_page.description: Candidates to return per page (default 25, max 500)

page.description: Page of results to return (default 1, max 500)

job_id.description: Optional Greenhouse job id: only candidates who applied to that job

email.description: Optional exact email address to filter by

updated_after.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp: only candidates updated at or after it

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: List an organization's Greenhouse departments (id, name, parent department)

per_page.description: Departments to return per page (default 25, max 500)

page.description: Page of results to return (default 1, max 500)

tools.name: list_offices
tools.description: List an organization's Greenhouse offices (id, name, location, parent office)

per_page.description: Offices to return per page (default 25, max 500)

page.description: Page of results to return (default 1, max 500)

needs_review: AUTH UNCHANGED from the scaffold: Harvest uses HTTP Basic with the API key as the username and an EMPTY password, which is exactly auth.type basic + userField api_key + passField "" (the docs' own samples send Authorization: Basic base64(<key>:)).
docs/tools_source point at https://docs.greenhouse.io/harvest.html because the scaffolded developers.greenhouse.io/harvest.html 301-redirects there; same document, canonical host.
READ-ONLY by design: all four tools are documented GET list endpoints and none is marked write:true. The Harvest write surface (POST/PATCH candidates, jobs, offices) is deliberately absent.

per_page is clamped to 500, which IS the documented maximum ('must be an integer between 1 and 500, defaults to 100'). page has no documented maximum, so its 500 ceiling is this spec's own conservative cap.

All four endpoints answer with a TOP-LEVEL JSON array, so each pick uses the spec v1.1 root-array form { "[]": {...} }. departments and offices also support render_as=tree, which is NOT exposed: the default list rendering is what the flat pick matches.
test keeps the scaffolded GET /v1/users (a documented Harvest endpoint) and adds per_page=1 so the credential check costs one record rather than a full page.
Harvest rate limits per the docs are 50 requests per 10 seconds (X-RateLimit-Limit), so this spec's 30 requests/minute cap sits well inside the provider's own ceiling.

Shape-proof 2026-09-12 (greenhouse.proof.json, runner shapeproof/1), verbatim: 'greenhouse  AUTH_WALL  proven=0 authwall=5 ambiguous=0 failed=0 inconclusive=0 skipped=0'. Harvest answers the bogus control path and all five real requests with the identical 401 {"message":"Invalid Basic Auth credentials"}, so the auth wall sits in front of routing: host, TLS and Basic-auth rejection are proven, and the five paths rest on the documented provenance above rather than on this run. Only a real API key can move these to SHAPE_PROVEN.
